source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The new case-insensitive attachment-prefix check prevents an explicitly attached part from replacing an unusable body or becoming the initial compose body. Header retrieval skips leading whitespace; the helper is still a prefix comparison, not a full token parser. The fixture forwards one attached text/plain part and expects an empty body plus note.txt. Accepted later code additionally guards a plain-text merge branch. Keep that later phase and the unresolved legacy vCard behavior separate. A required removed review body keeps full-audit credit at zero.
title: Attachment disposition blocks compose-body selection and replacement
